result.instructions: Tools for Cratejoy, hosted by usefulapi.io. If the user is new or asks what this server can do, suggest requests such as: "How many active subscriptions do I have, and which ones are past due?"; "Show last week's orders and their payment status."; "Which shipments are still unshipped?". Read-only tools never change data; ask the user before a tool that creates, changes or deletes Cratejoy data. Free plan: 50 tool calls per month. Run cratejoy_usage_status to see the calls used this month. If the user asks for something none of these tools can do, tell the user and, with their OK, run cratejoy_request_feature to record the request. Paid plan: Pro (unlimited tool calls (fair use limit: 10,000 a month), $9/month or $90/year). Pro can be cancelled at any time and then runs to the end of the paid period, so it also suits a one-time job. When the user wants more calls or reaches the limit, run cratejoy_upgrade (plan "monthly" or "yearly"); it returns a payment link for the user to open. cratejoy_cancel_subscription cancels Pro at the end of the paid period.

tools.name: cratejoy_get_store_metadata
tools.title: Get store metadata
tools.description: The store-level metadata record (id, store_id, created_at, updated_at, data: free-form JSON attached to the store). GET /v1/metadata/.

tools.name: cratejoy_list_customers
tools.title: List customers
tools.description: List customers (id, name, email, country, location, num_orders, num_subscriptions, subscription_status, total_revenue). Filter by email or name, or with `filters` (e.g. { 'addresses.city': 'Austin' }). Relationships: addresses, logs, carts, notes, orders, shipments, subscriptions. GET /v1/customers/.

filters.description: Extra Cratejoy filters as { '[relation.]property[__comparison]': value }. Comparisons: eq (default), ne, lt, le, gt, ge, like, ilike (% is the wildcard), in, nin (comma-separated), is_null. Status columns take integers. Example: { 'customer.email__like': '%@example.com' }.

with.description: Relationships to embed: comma-separated names (e.g. 'customer,orders'), 'all', or an empty string for none. Omit it for the vendor default.

page.description: Page number, counting from 0 (default 0). Pass the previous reply's next_page.

tools.name: cratejoy_skip_subscription_renewal
tools.title: Skip or unskip next renewal
tools.description: WRITE: skip a subscriber's next renewal (action 'skip') or undo the skip (action 'unskip'). Requires confirm=true. Repeating the same action changes nothing more. This changes a merchant customer's subscription in Cratejoy; it is not this server's own billing. PUT /v1/subscriptions/{sub_id}/skip/.

action.description: 'skip' skips the next renewal; 'unskip' restores it.

confirm.description: Must be true: confirms the customer's renewal schedule should change.

tools.name: cratejoy_cancel_customer_subscription
tools.title: Cancel a customer's subscription
tools.description: WRITE: cancel a subscriber's subscription in Cratejoy (the customer stops receiving boxes and renewals). This cancels the merchant's customer subscription, NOT this server's Pro plan (use the *_cancel_subscription tool for that). Requires confirm=true. A cancelled subscription can be restored with cratejoy_reactivate_subscription. PUT /v1/subscriptions/{sub_id}/cancel/.

confirm.description: Must be true: confirms the customer's subscription should be cancelled.

log_note.description: Optional note recorded in the subscription's log.

tools.name: cratejoy_reactivate_subscription
tools.title: Reactivate a customer's subscription
tools.description: WRITE: reactivate a cancelled subscription so it renews and charges the customer again. Requires confirm=true. Reactivating an active subscription changes nothing more. PUT /v1/subscriptions/{sub_id}/reactivate/.

confirm.description: Must be true: confirms the subscription should renew (and be charged) again.

log_note.description: Optional note recorded in the subscription's log.

tools.name: cratejoy_retry_subscription_renewal
tools.title: Retry a failed renewal
tools.description: WRITE: retry the renewal of a PAST-DUE subscription whose renewal failed within the last 30 days. This charges the customer's saved payment method. Requires confirm=true. PUT /v1/subscriptions/{sub_id}/renew/.

confirm.description: Must be true: confirms the customer's payment method should be charged.

log_note.description: Optional note recorded in the subscription's log.
